name: App A5: remove reacthub-pixitweenjs and Pixi from the app
description: Deletes the library player path and every Pixi use in web/, server/ and scripts/, rewrites the tests and dev pages that depended on the library, removes the packages from package.json and adds a repo-wide lint fence.

userStories.title: Delete the library player path
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one player path so that nothing in the studio imports the library.
steps: Read web/src/player/Player.tsx, PlayerBridge.tsx, useCompositionReady.ts and Player.test.tsx.

Remove the VITE_ENGINE switch and the library branch; delete PlayerBridge.tsx and useCompositionReady.ts if nothing else uses them; drop the Pixi capture path in web/src/capture/driver.ts and pixiTarget.ts in web/src/selection.
Update Player.test.tsx and capture/selection tests to the motion path only.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -rlE "reacthub-pixitweenjs|@pixi/" web/src/player web/src/capture web/src/selection prints nothing
Player, capture and selection tests pass

userStories.title: Rewrite or retire the library-based dev pages and agreement tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dev pages and tests that check our own schema and engine so that removing the library breaks nothing.
steps: Read web/src/dev/* (stage-check, three-check, FixturePage), web/*.html, web/src/panels/clip-check-main.tsx and the agreement tests web/src/*-agreement.test.tsx and web/src/engine-api.test.tsx.

Point the agreement tests at @shared/aep (schema) and web/src/motion/aep (converter): every fixture parses with parseAepCompositionSafe and converts with aepToMotion. Delete engine-api.test.tsx (it tested the library's exports).
Rewrite FixturePage and the dev pages to render through the motion Player, or delete a page whose purpose was a library bug (say which in notes) together with its .html stub.
acceptanceCriteria: The agreement tests pass and assert that every fixture converts with aepToMotion
notes lists every deleted file with a reason

userStories.title: Server and scripts: schema from @shared/aep, no library
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the server's validator and the preflight checks to use our schema so that the server has no library dependency.
steps: Read server/engine/validate.ts, server/lint-rules.test.ts and scripts/preflight/checks/engine.ts with its test.

Make getValidator() return the light validator directly (keep its behaviour; drop the dynamic library import) and keep its tests green; make the preflight engine check read the schema version from shared/aep/composition.ts instead of the library's package.json; update lint-rules.test.ts to test the new fence (US-004).
Fix the comment in server/product3d/types.ts that names the library schema version.
acceptanceCriteria: server and scripts tests that passed before still pass
userStories.notes: getValidator() hands out the light validator (no dynamic import, no warning). The preflight 'engine' check now reads the schema version from shared/aep/composition.ts and checks the versions the app writes against it (engine.schema, engine.written). The eslint fence for server/, shared/ and scripts/ now bans the library outright and keeps @shared/aep a type-only contract; server/lint-rules.test.ts reads the fenced packages out of the effective eslint config so it never names one. The comment in server/product3d/types.ts names our own schema now. Also removed the library name from scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts (the acceptance grep covers scripts/ too): the new-vs-existing check reads the schema version, and the demo-script label is now 'Engine: our own Three.js engine (built in this hackathon)'. Left for the owner: docs/new-vs-existing.md still names the library and its version, and docs/motion-kit.md still quotes the removed console.warn. npm test: 10 known failures, all in scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts (the owner's submission docs do not exist yet); the server/lint-rules.test.ts failure is fixed.

userStories.title: Uninstall the packages and fence the repo
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the packages gone and a lint rule that keeps them out so that the app is Three.js only.
steps: Read package.json, eslint.config.js and web/vite.config.ts (dedupe list).

npm uninstall reacthub-pixitweenjs pixi.js @pixi/react @pixi/sound pixi-filters gl-transitions @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei @react-three/postprocessing (keep any that a remaining import still needs and say which in notes); remove them from vite dedupe.
Add a repo-wide no-restricted-imports rule for these packages in eslint.config.js.
Run npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run lint and npm run build.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json lists none of the removed packages and npm run build succeeds
A temporary file web/src/tmp-check.ts importing 'pixi.js' fails npm run lint (delete it afterwards)
npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass
userStories.notes: Uninstalled all nine packages: reacthub-pixitweenjs, pixi.js, @pixi/react, @pixi/sound, pixi-filters, gl-transitions, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei and @react-three/postprocessing. None of them had to be kept: no file in server/, web/, shared/, scripts/, engine/, e2e/ or motion/ imported any of them any more (the only hits left were comments in the ported schema/engine files). Kept: three, postprocessing, gsap, @gsap/react, lottie-web and the rest, all still imported. eslint.config.js now has a repo-wide @typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports fence over the dropped packages; the server/ and engine/ blocks start from the same list because a flat config replaces a rule wholesale, so an area that narrows the rule has to carry the dropped packages with it. The unscoped packages are named exactly and the two scoped families are fenced as a group (@pixi/*, @react-three/*): naming @pixi/react *and* matching @pixi/* would report the same import twice. server/lint-rules.test.ts gained a test that every repo-wide fenced package is restricted in web/, server/, shared/, scripts/ and engine/. Removed 'pixi.js' and '@pixi/react' from the vite and vitest dedupe lists and the vitest server.deps.inline list. fixtures/s08a/seed-films/demo-mug/seed.test.ts parsed with the library; it now parses with our own @shared/aep parser. Acceptance check: a temporary web/src/tmp-check.ts importing 'pixi.js' fails npm run lint (deleted afterwards). npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm run build pass; npm test has the same 10 known failures as before (all in scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts, the owner's submission docs that do not exist yet) and one more test passing (the new fence test). Gotcha: the shell had NODE_ENV=production, so npm uninstall pruned the devDependencies as well; env -u NODE_ENV npm install --include=dev put them back.

metadata.standingRule: Engine PRD. Everything is offline and free: unit tests in vitest (jsdom project) and browser checks on the engine lab pages. The director app is not changed.
guardrails: Work offline. The only network use allowed is `npm install`. Tests never fetch; use the stored films under data/films/*/versions/*.json (read with node:fs) and assets under web/public.
Never commit, push, tag, publish to npm, deploy or change repository settings. autoCommit is off and the owner commits.

Read engine/docs/10-aep-adapter.md and engine/docs/README.md before writing code. The spec is the contract: if it is wrong or impossible, do the closest thing that works and explain the difference in notes.
The app's composition format is AepCompositionJson from `@shared/aep` (our own copy of the schema). Never import `reacthub-pixitweenjs`, `pixi.js`, `@pixi/*` or `pixi-filters` in new code.

Use the engine through `@engine/*` (engine/src). Do not edit engine/ except the files in metadata.sharedEdits; if the engine lacks something, add a row to docs/todos/ENGINE-NEEDS.md, use a workaround and say so in notes.
Edit only the files the story names, their tests, and metadata.sharedEdits. Do not change server/ behaviour, agent prompts or stored films.
No `@ts-nocheck` and no `@ts-ignore`. `@ts-expect-error` only with a reason on the same line.
jsdom has no 2D canvas context and no WebGL: unit-test pure logic; check drawing in the browser. Never weaken a test to make it pass.

Debug output and screenshots go to debug/app/ (gitignored). For a browser check use the dev server on http://localhost:5173 (already running; do not start another); headless Chromium through @playwright/test is fine.
Record only real results. Never invent measurements or test output.

`npm test` has 11 known failures outside your files (10 in scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts, 1 in web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx). Do not edit those files. The `npm test` gate passes when no other test fails.
npm uninstall is allowed for the packages this PRD removes (it rewrites package-lock.json); no other dependency changes.

The dev server on http://localhost:5173 is owner-run and shared: never kill, restart or stop it (no kill/pkill/lsof-kill on vite or port 5173). If it is down, use headless Chromium against `npx vite --config web/vite.config.ts --port 5180 --strictPort` started and stopped by you, and only that one.

ui: Verify in the browser: with the dev server on http://localhost:5173 (owner-run; else `npm run engine:e2e` once it exists), open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, save a screenshot to debug/engine/, and record what you saw in `notes`
